title: Firebird Chicken
description: Inspired by a stir-fry dish with the same name, Chef John's spicy marinade gives this firebird chicken recipe tons of flavor and juicy texture.
ingredients: 2 (8 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps.text: Combine habanero peppers, garlic, and salt in a mortar and pestle; mash into a fine paste. Whisk in Sriracha and egg to combine; set aside.
Remove tenderloins from breasts; slice each remaining breast in half lengthwise, cutting at a 45-degree angle to create two relatively equal strips.
Place all 6 chicken strips on a plate; generously dust all sides with rice flour until completely covered.

Pour habanero mixture over chicken strips using tongs to make sure each chicken strip is evenly coated and that there are no dry spots. Wrap the plate in plastic wrap; marinate in the refrigerator 2 to 12 hours.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook until well browned and no longer pink in centers, about 3 minutes per side. Serve immediately.

video.description: Give your lunch or dinner a spicy taste with this chicken recipe. In this video, Chef John makes his special firebird chicken, paired with rice and chives. The heated flavor comes from marinating the chicken in a hand-mashed mixture that contains both hot sauce and habaneros. After frying thoroughly, the flavor and consistency of the heat speaks for itself. Watch the video to see Chef John cook this hot chicken step-by-step.
